adaptations: Exact pure upstream recordexport and Markdown functions execute in isolated WebAssembly.
Existing commands retain inline Markdown by default and explicit Markdown support with Base-only read grants; explicit NDJSON or output filenames opt into artifact exports.
Filesystem export paths become grant-owned NDJSON and manifest artifacts; overwrite accepts a fresh isolated artifact.
Get requests the selected record IDs once before publishing NDJSON and manifest artifacts.
jq-records uses pinned gojq with deadline and output bounds and leaves saved artifacts unchanged.
